en.a778059b: Adults with rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic disease, acute gout, or psoriatic arthritis may take 1 to 3 capsules (200 to 600 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day, up to a maximum of 16 capsules (3,200 mg) a day. For juvenile rheumatoid arthritis (appearing at a young age), take 30 to 40 mg per kg of body weight a day, divided into 3 to 4 doses. For mild to moderate pain or the common cold, adults take 1 to 2 capsules (200 to 400 mg) per dose, 3 to 4 times a day. For migraine, adults take 1 to 2 capsules (200 to 400 mg) per dose, and do not exceed 2 capsules in 24 hours.
